name: md-pretty-view
description: A clean, polished look for Markdown Preview Enhanced: one-lever light/dark theme, an editor-style C# code palette, styled Mermaid diagrams, and Mermaid pan/zoom & fit-to-screen. Installs the styling into your Markdown Preview Enhanced config folder.

commands.title: MD Pretty View: Toggle Light / Dark

mdPrettyView.applyMpeSettings.description: When applying the theme, also set the recommended markdown-preview-enhanced.* settings globally (previewTheme none.css, codeBlockTheme vscode.css). Note: enabling Mermaid pan/zoom also turns on markdown-preview-enhanced.enableScriptExecution.
